title: SimCSE: Simple Contrastive Learning of Sentence Embeddings
description: SimCSE achieves state-of-the-art sentence embeddings using the simplest possible contrastive approach: pass the same sentence through a dropout-based encoder twice to get two views, treat them as positives, treat other sentences in the batch as negatives. Unsupervised SimCSE beats many supervised methods. Supervised SimCSE (with NLI pairs) sets the SOTA.
